test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 1 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

a. All books are fiction.

b. All fiction are sci-fi.

c. All sci-fi are movies.

**Conclusions:**

i. All movies are fiction.

ii. All sci-fi are books.

iii. All movies are books.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba537afc3deebe38c1417cfb61c777a7d7facf739e55f2b04ac584693f90d174.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All movies are fiction → Does not follow (As all fiction are sci-fi and all sci-fi are movies. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. All sci-fi are books → Does not follow (As all books are fiction and all fiction are sci-fi. So it is possible but not definite.)

III. All movies are books → Does not follow (As all books are fiction, all fiction are sci-fi and all sci-fi are movies. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, None of the conclusions follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
